answer: An agent economy can require every trading identity to lock a refundable bond for 90 days before submitting bids. An old account is no privileged relic: the same bond applies to everyone. This creates a reef of tied-up capital around the market; an attacker seeking 10,000 identities must lock 10,000 bonds. Splitting one wallet across aliases offers no shortcut onto the ledge, and the attacker pays financing costs throughout the lockup.
